## evoxc

### [evoxc.core](/api/evoxc/core/)

- [`BackendError`](/api/evoxc/core/backenderror/) — Raised when a backend cannot lower/compile/load/execute a program.
- [`DTypeError`](/api/evoxc/core/dtypeerror/) — Raised when an object cannot be normalized to a supported dtype, or a dtype is unsupported by an operation/backend.
- [`Device`](/api/evoxc/core/device/) — A physical device: a kind plus an optional index.
- [`DeviceError`](/api/evoxc/core/deviceerror/) — Raised on device errors: unknown device kind/index, device mismatch, interop (DLPack) failures, multi-device preparation errors.
- [`Dim`](/api/evoxc/core/dim/) — A named symbolic dimension with an optional known size.
- [`DimExpr`](/api/evoxc/core/dimexpr/) — An expression tree over symbolic dimensions.
- [`EVOXCError`](/api/evoxc/core/evoxcerror/) — Base class for all evoxc errors.
- [`PersistenceError`](/api/evoxc/core/persistenceerror/) — Raised on save/load failures: format mismatch, integrity failure, backend/device/ABI incompatibility.
- [`ShapeError`](/api/evoxc/core/shapeerror/) — Raised on shape/rank mismatches and failed shape inference.
- [`SymbolicTensor`](/api/evoxc/core/symbolictensor/) — An SSA value inside a graph — no storage, graph semantics only.
- [`Tensor`](/api/evoxc/core/tensor/) — A materialized runtime tensor.
- [`TensorSpec`](/api/evoxc/core/tensorspec/) — Describes a future runtime tensor (no storage).
- [`TraceError`](/api/evoxc/core/traceerror/) — Raised when a graph-building operation is used outside a valid trace.
- [`TransformError`](/api/evoxc/core/transformerror/) — Raised by graph→graph transforms (vectorize/vmap/grad/jvp/vjp).
- [`TreeSpec`](/api/evoxc/core/treespec/) — Structural description of a pytree (frozen; structural equality).
- [`VerificationError`](/api/evoxc/core/verificationerror/) — Raised when IR verification fails (malformed module, op operand/result mismatches, violated invariants).
- [`constant`](/api/evoxc/core/constant/) — Embed a concrete tensor's data into the graph as a Constant op.
- [`devices`](/api/evoxc/core/devices/) — Enumerate the devices actually available to this process.
- [`dim`](/api/evoxc/core/dim-function/) — Create a `Dim` from a name, a known size, or a `Dim`.
- [`dtype`](/api/evoxc/core/dtype/) — Normalize any dtype-like object to a `numpy.dtype`.
- [`empty`](/api/evoxc/core/empty/) — Create an uninitialized concrete tensor.
- [`flatten`](/api/evoxc/core/flatten/) — Flatten a pytree into `(leaves, treespec)`.
- [`from_dlpack`](/api/evoxc/core/from-dlpack/) — Import a tensor from any object exposing `__dlpack__` (zero-copy).
- [`from_numpy`](/api/evoxc/core/from-numpy/) — Wrap a numpy array as a `Tensor` without copying.
- [`full`](/api/evoxc/core/full/) — Create a concrete tensor filled with `fill_value`.
- [`ones`](/api/evoxc/core/ones/) — Create a concrete tensor filled with ones.
- [`register_backend_device_transfer_provider`](/api/evoxc/core/register-backend-device-transfer-provider/) — Register backend `backend`'s device-transfer provider for `kind`.
- [`register_device_transfer_provider`](/api/evoxc/core/register-device-transfer-provider/) — Register the FLAT DEFAULT device-transfer provider for kind `kind`.
- [`register_operator_handlers`](/api/evoxc/core/register-operator-handlers/) — Register the operator handler for `SymbolicTensor` dispatch kind `kind`.
- [`register_pytree_node`](/api/evoxc/core/register-pytree-node/) — Register a custom container type as a pytree node.
- [`replicate_tensor`](/api/evoxc/core/replicate-tensor/) — Replicate a local tensor onto each device (one tensor per device).
- [`split_tensor`](/api/evoxc/core/split-tensor/) — Split a local tensor along `axis` into one tensor per device.
- [`tensor`](/api/evoxc/core/tensor-function/) — Create a concrete tensor from array-like data.
- [`unflatten`](/api/evoxc/core/unflatten/) — Rebuild a pytree from leaves and a `TreeSpec`.
- [`zeros`](/api/evoxc/core/zeros/) — Create a concrete tensor filled with zeros.

### [evoxc.ir](/api/evoxc/ir/)

- [`AttrSpec`](/api/evoxc/ir/attrspec/) — One declared attribute of an op.
- [`Block`](/api/evoxc/ir/block/) — A basic block.
- [`Builder`](/api/evoxc/ir/builder/) — Constructs IR inside a `Module`.
- [`Function`](/api/evoxc/ir/function/) — A named function: typed signature + one region.
- [`Location`](/api/evoxc/ir/location/) — A source-code position.
- [`Module`](/api/evoxc/ir/module/) — The top-level IR unit: a versioned container of functions.
- [`Op`](/api/evoxc/ir/op/) — One instruction in a `Block`.
- [`OpDef`](/api/evoxc/ir/opdef/) — The declared contract of one op.
- [`Region`](/api/evoxc/ir/region/) — An ordered list of blocks.
- [`Use`](/api/evoxc/ir/use/) — One use of a Value: `owner.operands[operand_index] is value`.
- [`Value`](/api/evoxc/ir/value/) — An SSA value: a typed reference to a future runtime tensor in a graph.
- [`ValueType`](/api/evoxc/ir/valuetype/) — The type of an SSA value: a dtype and a symbolic shape.
- [`VerificationError`](/api/evoxc/core/verificationerror/) — Raised when IR verification fails (malformed module, op operand/result mismatches, violated invariants).
- [`all_opdefs`](/api/evoxc/ir/all-opdefs/) — All registered `OpDef`s (sorted by name).
- [`deserialize_module`](/api/evoxc/ir/deserialize-module/) — Rebuild a `Module` from a payload produced by `serialize_module`.
- [`has_opdef`](/api/evoxc/ir/has-opdef/) — True if an op with this name is registered.
- [`op_names`](/api/evoxc/ir/op-names/) — All registered op names (sorted).
- [`opdef`](/api/evoxc/ir/opdef-function/) — Look up the `OpDef` for an op name.
- [`pretty_print`](/api/evoxc/ir/pretty-print/) — Render `module` as readable SSA text (format above).
- [`register_opdef`](/api/evoxc/ir/register-opdef/) — Register an `OpDef` (idempotent per name).
- [`serialize_module`](/api/evoxc/ir/serialize-module/) — Serialize `module` into the self-describing payload dict above.
- [`verify`](/api/evoxc/ir/verify/) — Validate `module` against all EvoXIR invariants.

### [evoxc.ops](/api/evoxc/ops/)

- [`abs`](/api/evoxc/ops/abs/) — Elementwise absolute value.
- [`acos`](/api/evoxc/ops/acos/) — Elementwise arccosine.
- [`add`](/api/evoxc/ops/add/) — Elementwise addition (`x + y`).
- [`argmax`](/api/evoxc/ops/argmax/) — Index of the maximum along an axis (numpy `argmax` semantics).
- [`argmin`](/api/evoxc/ops/argmin/) — Index of the minimum along an axis (numpy `argmin` semantics).
- [`argsort`](/api/evoxc/ops/argsort/) — Indices that would sort the tensor along an axis (numpy `argsort` semantics).
- [`bitwise_and`](/api/evoxc/ops/bitwise-and/) — Elementwise bitwise AND (`x & y`).
- [`bitwise_left_shift`](/api/evoxc/ops/bitwise-left-shift/) — Elementwise bitwise left shift (`x << y`).
- [`bitwise_or`](/api/evoxc/ops/bitwise-or/) — Elementwise bitwise OR (`x | y`).
- [`bitwise_right_shift`](/api/evoxc/ops/bitwise-right-shift/) — Elementwise bitwise right shift (`x >> y`).
- [`bitwise_xor`](/api/evoxc/ops/bitwise-xor/) — Elementwise bitwise XOR (`x ^ y`).
- [`broadcast`](/api/evoxc/ops/broadcast/) — Broadcast to the target shape (numpy `broadcast_to` semantics).
- [`cast`](/api/evoxc/ops/cast/) — Cast to the given dtype.
- [`ceil`](/api/evoxc/ops/ceil/) — Elementwise ceiling (numpy semantics; integer input is unchanged).
- [`cholesky`](/api/evoxc/ops/cholesky/) — Lower-triangular Cholesky factor (numpy `linalg.cholesky`).
- [`clamp`](/api/evoxc/ops/clamp/) — Clamp values into `[min, max]` (numpy `clip` semantics).
- [`concatenate`](/api/evoxc/ops/concatenate/) — Concatenate tensors along an axis (numpy `concatenate` semantics).
- [`constant`](/api/evoxc/ops/constant/) — Embed a concrete `Tensor` into the graph as a Constant op.
- [`conv`](/api/evoxc/ops/conv/) — N-dimensional convolution (Nx `conv` semantics, NCHW default).
- [`cos`](/api/evoxc/ops/cos/) — Elementwise cosine.
- [`cumprod`](/api/evoxc/ops/cumprod/) — Cumulative product along an axis (numpy `cumprod` semantics plus an optional reverse scan direction, mirroring `cumsum`).
- [`cumsum`](/api/evoxc/ops/cumsum/) — Cumulative sum along an axis (numpy `cumsum` semantics plus an optional reverse scan direction).
- [`custom_call`](/api/evoxc/ops/custom-call/) — Call a named StableHLO custom-call target at compile time.
- [`diag`](/api/evoxc/ops/diag/) — Extract the main diagonal, or build a diagonal matrix (numpy `diag` semantics).
- [`diagonal`](/api/evoxc/ops/diagonal/) — Extract the diagonal of a 2-D slice (numpy `diagonal` semantics).
- [`divide`](/api/evoxc/ops/divide/) — Elementwise true division (`x / y`).
- [`dot`](/api/evoxc/ops/dot/) — Batched matrix multiplication (`a @ b`).
- [`eigh`](/api/evoxc/ops/eigh/) — Hermitian/symmetric eigendecomposition (numpy `linalg.eigh`).
- [`equal`](/api/evoxc/ops/equal/) — Elementwise equality (`x == y`) → bool.
- [`erf`](/api/evoxc/ops/erf/) — Elementwise Gauss error function.
- [`exp`](/api/evoxc/ops/exp/) — Elementwise exponential.
- [`external_call`](/api/evoxc/ops/external-call/) — Call an externally-registered kernel by NAME at run time.
- [`eye`](/api/evoxc/ops/eye/) — Identity matrix (numpy `eye` semantics) as a Constant op.
- [`flip`](/api/evoxc/ops/flip/) — Reverse the tensor along the given axes (numpy `flip` semantics).
- [`floor`](/api/evoxc/ops/floor/) — Elementwise floor (numpy semantics; integer input is unchanged).
- [`gather`](/api/evoxc/ops/gather/) — Gather entries along an axis (numpy `take` semantics).
- [`gelu`](/api/evoxc/ops/gelu/) — Elementwise Gaussian Error Linear Unit (exact erf form, `0.5 * x * (1 + erf(x / sqrt(2)))`).
- [`greater`](/api/evoxc/ops/greater/) — Elementwise strict greater-than (`x > y`) → bool.
- [`greater_equal`](/api/evoxc/ops/greater-equal/) — Elementwise greater-or-equal (`x >= y`) → bool.
- [`inline_stablehlo`](/api/evoxc/ops/inline-stablehlo/) — Emit a raw StableHLO/MLIR snippet verbatim as this op's lowering.
- [`isnan`](/api/evoxc/ops/isnan/) — Elementwise NaN test (numpy `isnan` semantics) → bool tensor.
- [`less`](/api/evoxc/ops/less/) — Elementwise strict less-than (`x < y`) → bool.
- [`less_equal`](/api/evoxc/ops/less-equal/) — Elementwise less-or-equal (`x <= y`) → bool.
- [`linspace`](/api/evoxc/ops/linspace/) — Evenly spaced numbers (numpy `linspace` semantics) as a Constant op.
- [`log`](/api/evoxc/ops/log/) — Elementwise natural logarithm.
- [`log1p`](/api/evoxc/ops/log1p/) — Elementwise `log(1 + x)`, computed as a single op (numerically accurate near 0).
- [`logical_and`](/api/evoxc/ops/logical-and/) — Elementwise logical AND (`x & y` over bools) → bool.
- [`logical_not`](/api/evoxc/ops/logical-not/) — Elementwise logical NOT (`~x` over bools) → bool.
- [`logical_or`](/api/evoxc/ops/logical-or/) — Elementwise logical OR (`x | y` over bools) → bool.
- [`matmul`](/api/evoxc/ops/matmul/) — Matrix product with numpy `matmul` semantics (1-D support).
- [`matrix_exp`](/api/evoxc/ops/matrix-exp/) — Matrix exponential (scipy `linalg.expm` / torch semantics — numpy has no `linalg.matrix_exp`).
- [`matrix_rank`](/api/evoxc/ops/matrix-rank/) — Numerical rank via SVD (numpy `linalg.matrix_rank`).
- [`max`](/api/evoxc/ops/max/) — User-facing sugar: EXACTLY `reduce_max(x, axes=axes, keepdims=keepdims)`.
- [`maximum`](/api/evoxc/ops/maximum/) — Elementwise maximum (numpy `maximum`, not the reduction `max`).
- [`mean`](/api/evoxc/ops/mean/) — User-facing sugar: EXACTLY `reduce_mean(x, axes=axes, keepdims=keepdims)`.
- [`median`](/api/evoxc/ops/median/) — Median (numpy `median` semantics: always returns `float64`).
- [`min`](/api/evoxc/ops/min/) — User-facing sugar: EXACTLY `reduce_min(x, axes=axes, keepdims=keepdims)`.
- [`minimum`](/api/evoxc/ops/minimum/) — Elementwise minimum (numpy `minimum`, not the reduction `min`).
- [`multiply`](/api/evoxc/ops/multiply/) — Elementwise multiplication (`x * y`).
- [`nan_to_num`](/api/evoxc/ops/nan-to-num/) — Replace NaN / +inf / -inf entries (numpy `nan_to_num` semantics).
- [`nansum`](/api/evoxc/ops/nansum/) — Sum treating NaN as 0 (numpy `nansum` semantics).
- [`negate`](/api/evoxc/ops/negate/) — Elementwise negation (`-x`).
- [`norm`](/api/evoxc/ops/norm/) — Vector norm (numpy `linalg.norm` semantics for vectors).
- [`not_equal`](/api/evoxc/ops/not-equal/) — Elementwise inequality (`x != y`) → bool.
- [`pad`](/api/evoxc/ops/pad/) — Pad a tensor with a constant value (Nx `pad` semantics).
- [`power`](/api/evoxc/ops/power/) — Elementwise power (`x ** y`).
- [`prod`](/api/evoxc/ops/prod/) — User-facing sugar: EXACTLY `reduce_prod(x, axes=axes, keepdims=keepdims)`.
- [`qr`](/api/evoxc/ops/qr/) — QR factorization (numpy `linalg.qr`, reduced mode).
- [`reduce_max`](/api/evoxc/ops/reduce-max/) — Maximum of elements over the given axes.
- [`reduce_mean`](/api/evoxc/ops/reduce-mean/) — Arithmetic mean of elements over the given axes.
- [`reduce_min`](/api/evoxc/ops/reduce-min/) — Minimum of elements over the given axes.
- [`reduce_prod`](/api/evoxc/ops/reduce-prod/) — Product of elements over the given axes.
- [`reduce_sum`](/api/evoxc/ops/reduce-sum/) — Sum of elements over the given axes.
- [`relu`](/api/evoxc/ops/relu/) — Elementwise rectified linear unit `max(x, 0)`.
- [`remainder`](/api/evoxc/ops/remainder/) — Elementwise remainder of division: numpy `remainder` is floormod — the result has the sign of the DIVISOR and satisfies `x == (x // y) * y + x % y` (Python `%` semantics).
- [`reshape`](/api/evoxc/ops/reshape/) — Reshape to the given shape.
- [`roll`](/api/evoxc/ops/roll/) — Roll the tensor by a shift (numpy `roll` semantics).
- [`round`](/api/evoxc/ops/round/) — Elementwise round-half-to-even (numpy `round` semantics; integer input is unchanged).
- [`runtime_call`](/api/evoxc/ops/runtime-call/) — Call an arbitrary Python callback at run time (explicit escape hatch).
- [`scatter`](/api/evoxc/ops/scatter/) — Scatter `updates` into a COPY of `x` at `indices` along an axis (numpy `put`-along-axis / JAX `scatter`-update semantics; `x` is never mutated).
- [`select`](/api/evoxc/ops/select/) — Elementwise ternary selection: `on_true` where `pred` is truthy, `on_false` elsewhere (numpy `where` semantics, SSA — both branches are always evaluated).
- [`sigmoid`](/api/evoxc/ops/sigmoid/) — Elementwise logistic sigmoid `1 / (1 + exp(-x))`.
- [`sign`](/api/evoxc/ops/sign/) — Elementwise sign (-1, 0, +1 per numpy; complex input returns the complex sign).
- [`sin`](/api/evoxc/ops/sin/) — Elementwise sine.
- [`slice`](/api/evoxc/ops/slice/) — Static strided slice (Nx `slice` semantics).
- [`solve`](/api/evoxc/ops/solve/) — Solve linear systems `a x = b` (numpy `linalg.solve` semantics).
- [`sort`](/api/evoxc/ops/sort/) — Sort the tensor along an axis (numpy `sort` semantics).
- [`sqrt`](/api/evoxc/ops/sqrt/) — Elementwise square root.
- [`square`](/api/evoxc/ops/square/) — Elementwise square (`x * x`).
- [`stack`](/api/evoxc/ops/stack/) — Stack tensors along a new axis (numpy `stack` semantics).
- [`std`](/api/evoxc/ops/std/) — Standard deviation (numpy `std` semantics).
- [`stop_gradient`](/api/evoxc/ops/stop-gradient/) — Barrier op: value passes through unchanged, gradient is zero.
- [`subtract`](/api/evoxc/ops/subtract/) — Elementwise subtraction (`x - y`).
- [`sum`](/api/evoxc/ops/sum/) — User-facing sugar: `sum(x, axes, keepdims)` is EXACTLY `reduce_sum(x, axes=axes, keepdims=keepdims)` — no other semantics.
- [`svd`](/api/evoxc/ops/svd/) — Singular value decomposition (numpy `linalg.svd`, `full_matrices=False`).
- [`tan`](/api/evoxc/ops/tan/) — Elementwise tangent.
- [`tanh`](/api/evoxc/ops/tanh/) — Elementwise hyperbolic tangent.
- [`tile`](/api/evoxc/ops/tile/) — Repeat the tensor per numpy `tile` semantics.
- [`topk`](/api/evoxc/ops/topk/) — Top-k values and their indices along an axis.
- [`trace`](/api/evoxc/ops/trace/) — Sum of the diagonal of a 2-D slice (numpy `trace` semantics).
- [`transpose`](/api/evoxc/ops/transpose/) — Permute tensor axes (numpy `transpose` semantics).
- [`tril`](/api/evoxc/ops/tril/) — Lower triangle of the last two dims (numpy `tril` semantics); batch dims are preserved as-is.
- [`triu`](/api/evoxc/ops/triu/) — Upper triangle of the last two dims (numpy `triu` semantics); batch dims are preserved as-is.
- [`var`](/api/evoxc/ops/var/) — Variance (numpy `var` semantics).

### [evoxc.numpy](/api/evoxc/numpy/)

- [`abs`](/api/evoxc/numpy/abs/) — numpy.abs(x) → ops.abs(x).
- [`add`](/api/evoxc/numpy/add/) — numpy.add → ops.add(a, b).
- [`arange`](/api/evoxc/numpy/arange/) — numpy.arange → Constant op with numpy.arange(start, stop, step) data.
- [`argmax`](/api/evoxc/numpy/argmax/) — numpy.argmax → ops.argmax(a, axis=axis, keepdims=keepdims).
- [`argmin`](/api/evoxc/numpy/argmin/) — numpy.argmin → ops.argmin(a, axis=axis, keepdims=keepdims).
- [`astype`](/api/evoxc/numpy/astype/) — numpy.ndarray.astype as a function → ops.cast(a, dtype).
- [`broadcast_to`](/api/evoxc/numpy/broadcast-to/) — numpy.broadcast_to → ops.broadcast(a, shape).
- [`clip`](/api/evoxc/numpy/clip/) — numpy.clip → ops.maximum(ops.minimum(a, a_max), a_min).
- [`concatenate`](/api/evoxc/numpy/concatenate/) — numpy.concatenate → ops.concatenate(arrays, axis=axis).
- [`cos`](/api/evoxc/numpy/cos/) — numpy.cos → ops.cos(x).
- [`cumsum`](/api/evoxc/numpy/cumsum/) — numpy.cumsum → ops.cumsum.
- [`divide`](/api/evoxc/numpy/divide/) — numpy.divide → ops.divide(a, b).
- [`dot`](/api/evoxc/numpy/dot/) — numpy.dot → ops.dot(a, b) (v1 alias of matmul).
- [`empty`](/api/evoxc/numpy/empty/) — numpy.empty → Constant op wrapping an uninitialized array (graph op).
- [`equal`](/api/evoxc/numpy/equal/) — numpy.equal → ops.equal(a, b).
- [`exp`](/api/evoxc/numpy/exp/) — numpy.exp → ops.exp(x).
- [`expand_dims`](/api/evoxc/numpy/expand-dims/) — numpy.expand_dims → ops.reshape with size-1 dims inserted at axis.
- [`full`](/api/evoxc/numpy/full/) — numpy.full → Constant op filled with fill_value (graph op).
- [`greater`](/api/evoxc/numpy/greater/) — numpy.greater → ops.greater(a, b).
- [`greater_equal`](/api/evoxc/numpy/greater-equal/) — numpy.greater_equal → ops.greater_equal(a, b).
- [`less`](/api/evoxc/numpy/less/) — numpy.less → ops.less(a, b).
- [`less_equal`](/api/evoxc/numpy/less-equal/) — numpy.less_equal → ops.less_equal(a, b).
- [`log`](/api/evoxc/numpy/log/) — numpy.log → ops.log(x).
- [`logical_and`](/api/evoxc/numpy/logical-and/) — numpy.logical_and → ops.logical_and(a, b).
- [`logical_not`](/api/evoxc/numpy/logical-not/) — numpy.logical_not → ops.logical_not(a).
- [`logical_or`](/api/evoxc/numpy/logical-or/) — numpy.logical_or → ops.logical_or(a, b).
- [`matmul`](/api/evoxc/numpy/matmul/) — numpy.matmul → ops.dot(a, b).
- [`max`](/api/evoxc/numpy/max/) — numpy.max → ops.max (reduce_max).
- [`maximum`](/api/evoxc/numpy/maximum/) — numpy.maximum → ops.maximum(a, b).
- [`mean`](/api/evoxc/numpy/mean/) — numpy.mean → ops.mean (reduce_mean).
- [`min`](/api/evoxc/numpy/min/) — numpy.min → ops.min (reduce_min).
- [`minimum`](/api/evoxc/numpy/minimum/) — numpy.minimum → ops.minimum(a, b).
- [`multiply`](/api/evoxc/numpy/multiply/) — numpy.multiply → ops.multiply(a, b).
- [`negative`](/api/evoxc/numpy/negative/) — numpy.negative → ops.negate(x).
- [`not_equal`](/api/evoxc/numpy/not-equal/) — numpy.not_equal → ops.not_equal(a, b).
- [`ones`](/api/evoxc/numpy/ones/) — numpy.ones → Constant op filled with ones (graph op).
- [`pad`](/api/evoxc/numpy/pad/) — numpy.pad → ops.pad(...).
- [`power`](/api/evoxc/numpy/power/) — numpy.power → ops.power(a, b).
- [`prod`](/api/evoxc/numpy/prod/) — numpy.prod → ops.prod (reduce_prod).
- [`reshape`](/api/evoxc/numpy/reshape/) — numpy.reshape → ops.reshape(a, shape).
- [`sign`](/api/evoxc/numpy/sign/) — numpy.sign → ops.sign(x).
- [`sin`](/api/evoxc/numpy/sin/) — numpy.sin → ops.sin(x).
- [`split`](/api/evoxc/numpy/split/) — numpy.split → composition of ops.slice along axis.
- [`sqrt`](/api/evoxc/numpy/sqrt/) — numpy.sqrt → ops.sqrt(x).
- [`square`](/api/evoxc/numpy/square/) — numpy.square → ops.square(x).
- [`squeeze`](/api/evoxc/numpy/squeeze/) — numpy.squeeze → ops.reshape with size-1 dims dropped.
- [`stack`](/api/evoxc/numpy/stack/) — numpy.stack → expand_dims(each array, axis) + concatenate(axis).
- [`subtract`](/api/evoxc/numpy/subtract/) — numpy.subtract → ops.subtract(a, b).
- [`sum`](/api/evoxc/numpy/sum/) — numpy.sum → ops.sum (reduce_sum).
- [`tanh`](/api/evoxc/numpy/tanh/) — numpy.tanh → ops.tanh(x).
- [`transpose`](/api/evoxc/numpy/transpose/) — numpy.transpose → ops.transpose(a, axes).
- [`tril`](/api/evoxc/numpy/tril/) — numpy.tril → ops.tril(a, k=k).
- [`triu`](/api/evoxc/numpy/triu/) — numpy.triu → ops.triu(a, k=k).
- [`where`](/api/evoxc/numpy/where/) — numpy.where(cond, x, y) → ops.select(cond, x, y).
- [`zeros`](/api/evoxc/numpy/zeros/) — numpy.zeros → Constant op filled with zeros (graph op).

### [evoxc.trace](/api/evoxc/trace/)

- [`Defn`](/api/evoxc/trace/defn/) — A marked graph definition.
- [`Graph`](/api/evoxc/trace/graph/) — A traced graph: IR module plus the input/output trees that let the pipeline flatten/validate/unflatten structured data around the module.
- [`StaticValue`](/api/evoxc/trace/staticvalue/) — Record of one static (graph-specializing) input or output leaf.
- [`cond`](/api/evoxc/trace/cond/) — Runtime `if` over a tensor predicate → traced `if` op.
- [`current_builder`](/api/evoxc/trace/current-builder/) — Return the innermost active `ir.Builder`.
- [`defn`](/api/evoxc/trace/defn-function/) — Mark `fn` as a graph definition.
- [`scan`](/api/evoxc/trace/scan/) — Scan along a leading axis → `(carry, stacked_outputs)`.
- [`trace`](/api/evoxc/trace/trace/) — Trace `fn_or_defn` with the given input specs → `Graph`.
- [`while_loop`](/api/evoxc/trace/while-loop/) — Runtime `while` over a tensor condition → traced `while` op.
- [`with_builder`](/api/evoxc/trace/with-builder/) — Context manager installing `builder` as the active builder for ops.

### [evoxc.transforms](/api/evoxc/transforms/)

- [`BatchReport`](/api/evoxc/transforms/batchreport/) — What one `batch_functions` merge actually did (the `batch_report`).
- [`BoundaryValue`](/api/evoxc/transforms/boundaryvalue/) — One tensor crossing the `prepare` → `apply` boundary.
- [`InputAnalysis`](/api/evoxc/transforms/inputanalysis/) — The result of `analyze_inputs`: the per-input facts of one graph.
- [`InputInfo`](/api/evoxc/transforms/inputinfo/) — Per-tensor-input facts of one traced graph (`analyze_inputs`).
- [`SplitCallable`](/api/evoxc/transforms/splitcallable/) — Returned by `split_by_inputs` when given a callable/`Defn`.
- [`SplitPlan`](/api/evoxc/transforms/splitplan/) — The result of `split_by_inputs`: a `prepare` / `apply` graph pair.
- [`SwitchRecord`](/api/evoxc/transforms/switchrecord/) — One switch class emitted by `batch_functions`.
- [`TransformCallable`](/api/evoxc/transforms/transformcallable/) — Returned by transforms applied to a callable/`Defn`.
- [`analyze_inputs`](/api/evoxc/transforms/analyze-inputs/) — Report the per-tensor-input facts of a traced graph.
- [`batch_functions`](/api/evoxc/transforms/batch-functions/) — Merge N same-signature programs into one graph with a function axis.
- [`grad`](/api/evoxc/transforms/grad/) — Reverse-mode gradients: inputs → gradients w.r.t.
- [`jvp`](/api/evoxc/transforms/jvp/) — Forward-mode differentiation: push tangents through the computation.
- [`register_batched_aux_remap`](/api/evoxc/transforms/register-batched-aux-remap/) — Register (or replace) the batched-output aux remap fn for `node_type`.
- [`register_batching_rule`](/api/evoxc/transforms/register-batching-rule/) — Register (or replace) the batching rule for `op_name`.
- [`register_jvp_rule`](/api/evoxc/transforms/register-jvp-rule/) — Register (or replace) the JVP rule for `op_name`.
- [`register_vjp_rule`](/api/evoxc/transforms/register-vjp-rule/) — Register (or replace) the VJP rule for `op_name`.
- [`split_by_inputs`](/api/evoxc/transforms/split-by-inputs/) — Split a graph into a `prepare` / `apply` pair at its input structure.
- [`vectorize`](/api/evoxc/transforms/vectorize/) — Vectorize a traced graph via per-op batching rules.
- [`vjp`](/api/evoxc/transforms/vjp/) — Reverse-mode differentiation: pull cotangents back to the inputs.
- [`vmap`](/api/evoxc/transforms/vmap/) — Vectorize a function or graph over a leading axis (function-side sugar).

### [evoxc.block](/api/evoxc/block/)

- [`AttributeField`](/api/evoxc/block/attributefield/) — One declared static attribute of a BlockOp.
- [`BatchingPolicy`](/api/evoxc/block/batchingpolicy/) — How `vectorize`/`vmap` may treat a `block_call` op.
- [`BlockError`](/api/evoxc/block/blockerror/) — Invalid block declaration or static misuse of a `BlockOp`.
- [`BlockOp`](/api/evoxc/block/blockop/) — A declared custom operation, callable to build `block_call` IR ops.
- [`StaticValue`](/api/evoxc/block/staticvalue/) — Serialized static (Python) value recorded on a `block_call` op.
- [`block`](/api/evoxc/block/block/) — Declare a custom operation — factory form or decorator form.
- [`get_block`](/api/evoxc/block/get-block/) — Return the BlockOp registered under `name`.

### [evoxc.backends](/api/evoxc/backends/)

- [`Backend`](/api/evoxc/backends/backend/) — Abstract staging backend: graph → lowered program → compiled artifact → executable.
- [`Capabilities`](/api/evoxc/backends/capabilities/) — Static capability declaration of a backend.
- [`CompiledArtifact`](/api/evoxc/backends/compiledartifact/) — Compiled, self-describing artifact (post-`compile` staging object).
- [`CompilerBackend`](/api/evoxc/backends/compilerbackend/) — Shared base for compiler backends that consume StableHLO MLIR.
- [`CompilerExecutable`](/api/evoxc/backends/compilerexecutable/) — Base class for compiler-adapter executables (satisfies `Executable`).
- [`Executable`](/api/evoxc/backends/executable/) — Protocol implemented by backend-specific executables.
- [`LoweredProgram`](/api/evoxc/backends/loweredprogram/) — Backend-specific lowered form of a Graph (pre-compile staging object).
- [`NumpyBackend`](/api/evoxc/backends/numpybackend/) — Default reference CPU backend: a pure-Python numpy interpreter.
- [`NumpyExecutable`](/api/evoxc/backends/numpyexecutable/) — Backend executable for the numpy interpreter (satisfies `Executable`).
- [`Signature`](/api/evoxc/backends/signature/) — Input/output contract recorded at `lower()` time, passed down from the Graph.
- [`get`](/api/evoxc/backends/get/) — Look up a backend by name; activate optional adapters / entry points.
- [`register`](/api/evoxc/backends/register/) — Register a backend under `backend.name`.
- [`unregister`](/api/evoxc/backends/unregister/) — Remove and return the backend registered under `name`.

### [evoxc.pipeline](/api/evoxc/pipeline/)

- [`BoundExecutable`](/api/evoxc/pipeline/boundexecutable/) — Result of `evoxc.bind`: an executable with pre-supplied inputs.
- [`Executable`](/api/evoxc/pipeline/executable/) — User-facing executable: a backend executable + structured signature.
- [`bind`](/api/evoxc/pipeline/bind/) — `bind(executable, w=w) -> BoundExecutable` — argument-supply sugar.
- [`build`](/api/evoxc/pipeline/build/) — `build(f, *specs) -> Executable`.
- [`compile`](/api/evoxc/pipeline/compile/) — `compile(lowered) -> CompiledArtifact`.
- [`compile_text`](/api/evoxc/pipeline/compile-text/) — `compile_text(mlir_text, input_specs, output_specs) -> Executable`.
- [`evaluate`](/api/evoxc/pipeline/evaluate/) — `evaluate(f, *tensors) -> structured outputs`.
- [`load`](/api/evoxc/pipeline/load/) — `load(artifact) -> Executable`.
- [`lower`](/api/evoxc/pipeline/lower/) — `lower(graph) -> LoweredProgram`.
- [`run`](/api/evoxc/pipeline/run/) — `run(executable, *tensors) -> structured outputs`.

### [evoxc.dist](/api/evoxc/dist/)

- [`Group`](/api/evoxc/dist/group/) — A named set of ranks that explicit collectives operate over.
- [`RankContext`](/api/evoxc/dist/rankcontext/) — Runtime rank context passed to collective executors.
- [`all_gather`](/api/evoxc/dist/all-gather/) — All-gather: concatenate the local tensors of all ranks along `axis`.
- [`all_reduce`](/api/evoxc/dist/all-reduce/) — All-reduce: combine `tensor` across all ranks of `group` with `op`.
- [`all_to_all`](/api/evoxc/dist/all-to-all/) — All-to-all: scatter along `split_axis`, gather along `concat_axis`.
- [`broadcast`](/api/evoxc/dist/broadcast/) — Broadcast: every rank receives the local tensor of `src_rank`.
- [`collective_permute`](/api/evoxc/dist/collective-permute/) — Collective permute: pairwise send/recv per `source_target_pairs`.
- [`get_collective_executor`](/api/evoxc/dist/get-collective-executor/) — Return the installed collective executor.
- [`group`](/api/evoxc/dist/group-function/) — Create an explicit communication `Group`.
- [`rank`](/api/evoxc/dist/rank/) — Current rank of the runtime execution context, as a scalar int64 graph value.
- [`reduce_scatter`](/api/evoxc/dist/reduce-scatter/) — Reduce-scatter: reduce across ranks with `op`, then scatter along `axis`.
- [`set_collective_executor`](/api/evoxc/dist/set-collective-executor/) — Install (or clear, with `None`) the process-wide collective executor.
- [`world_size`](/api/evoxc/dist/world-size/) — World size of the runtime execution context, scalar int64 graph value.

### [evoxc.sparse](/api/evoxc/sparse/)

- [`CSCTensor`](/api/evoxc/sparse/csctensor/) — Concrete CSC sparse tensor: `(indptr, indices, values)` leaves.
- [`CSRTensor`](/api/evoxc/sparse/csrtensor/) — Concrete CSR sparse tensor: `(indptr, indices, values)` leaves.
- [`SparseTensor`](/api/evoxc/sparse/sparsetensor/) — Sparse tensor — base class AND the concrete COO representation.
- [`SparseTensorSpec`](/api/evoxc/sparse/sparsetensorspec/) — Spec-phase sparse tensor: the leaves are `core.TensorSpec`.
- [`add`](/api/evoxc/sparse/add/) — Sparse + sparse with a union merge (overlapping entries summed).
- [`concatenate`](/api/evoxc/sparse/concatenate/) — Concatenate >= 2 sparse tensors along one sparse axis (variadic).
- [`coo`](/api/evoxc/sparse/coo/) — Construct a COO sparse tensor from raw components.
- [`csc`](/api/evoxc/sparse/csc/) — Construct a CSC sparse tensor from raw components.
- [`csr`](/api/evoxc/sparse/csr/) — Construct a CSR sparse tensor from raw components.
- [`from_dense`](/api/evoxc/sparse/from-dense/) — Extract the exact non-zero entries of a dense tensor into a COO sparse.
- [`is_sparse`](/api/evoxc/sparse/is-sparse/) — True if `x` is a sparse tensor in ANY phase or variant.
- [`matmul`](/api/evoxc/sparse/matmul/) — Sparse/dense matmul, dispatching on the operand kinds.
- [`multiply`](/api/evoxc/sparse/multiply/) — Sparse * sparse with an intersection merge (overlapping entries multiplied); the union structure is dropped.
- [`multiply_dense`](/api/evoxc/sparse/multiply-dense/) — Sparse * dense elementwise: structure preserved, values scaled by the dense tensor.
- [`negate`](/api/evoxc/sparse/negate/) — Negate the sparse values; the sparsity structure is preserved.
- [`reshape`](/api/evoxc/sparse/reshape/) — Reshape the sparse tensor to a new dense shape (element count equal).
- [`subtract`](/api/evoxc/sparse/subtract/) — Sparse - sparse: composed as `add(a, negate(b))` (no dedicated op).
- [`sum`](/api/evoxc/sparse/sum/) — Sum the sparse values over the given (unbatched) sparse axes -> DENSE.
- [`to_coo`](/api/evoxc/sparse/to-coo/) — Convert a sparse tensor to canonical COO.
- [`to_csc`](/api/evoxc/sparse/to-csc/) — Convert a sparse tensor to CSC.
- [`to_csr`](/api/evoxc/sparse/to-csr/) — Convert a sparse tensor to CSR.
- [`to_dense`](/api/evoxc/sparse/to-dense/) — Materialize the dense tensor described by a sparse tensor.
- [`transpose`](/api/evoxc/sparse/transpose/) — Permute the sparse axes; the result is COO with the permuted shape.

### [evoxc.persist](/api/evoxc/persist/)

- [`Cache`](/api/evoxc/persist/cache/) — Explicit cache interface (no global state; instances are user-owned).
- [`FileCache`](/api/evoxc/persist/filecache/) — Filesystem-backed `Cache`: one container file per key, sharded.
- [`LoadedObject`](/api/evoxc/persist/loadedobject/) — Result of `load_object`: a dict with both key and attribute access.
- [`compute_key`](/api/evoxc/persist/compute-key/) — Derive the deterministic cache key (64-char lowercase sha256 hex).
- [`decode_value`](/api/evoxc/persist/decode-value/) — Decode an envelope dict (as produced by `encode_value`) back to a value.
- [`encode_value`](/api/evoxc/persist/encode-value/) — Encode `value` into a JSON-safe envelope dict (see module docstring).
- [`load_object`](/api/evoxc/persist/load-object/) — Read + validate the container at `path`; return a `LoadedObject`.
- [`register_codec`](/api/evoxc/persist/register-codec/) — Register a codec pair in the global registry (trivial registry insert).
- [`save_object`](/api/evoxc/persist/save-object/) — Write the standard container to `path` (atomic).

### [evoxc.formats](/api/evoxc/formats/)

- [`GGUFFile`](/api/evoxc/formats/gguffile/) — An open, validated GGUF v2/v3 file (metadata + tensor infos + data).
- [`SafetensorsFile`](/api/evoxc/formats/safetensorsfile/) — An open, validated safetensors file.
- [`TensorInfo`](/api/evoxc/formats/tensorinfo/) — Metadata for one tensor stored in a container file.
- [`load_gguf`](/api/evoxc/formats/load-gguf/) — Open and validate a GGUF v2/v3 file.
- [`load_safetensors`](/api/evoxc/formats/load-safetensors/) — Open and validate a safetensors file.
- [`save_safetensors`](/api/evoxc/formats/save-safetensors/) — Write `tensors` to `path` in canonical safetensors layout.

### [evoxc.external](/api/evoxc/external/)

- [`ExternalKernel`](/api/evoxc/external/externalkernel/) — Handle returned by `register_external_kernel` — the registration surface for one external kernel.
- [`get_external_kernel`](/api/evoxc/external/get-external-kernel/) — The callable for `name` at `backend` (`None` if unknown).
- [`get_external_kernel_entry`](/api/evoxc/external/get-external-kernel-entry/) — The `(callable, device_resident)` entry for `name` at `backend`.
- [`get_portable`](/api/evoxc/external/get-portable/) — The registered portable (`@evoxc.defn`) implementation for `name`.
- [`register_external_kernel`](/api/evoxc/external/register-external-kernel/) — Register `callable_` as the external kernel named `name`.
- [`register_portable`](/api/evoxc/external/register-portable/) — Register the optional graph decomposition for kernel `name`.
- [`unregister_external_kernel`](/api/evoxc/external/unregister-external-kernel/) — Remove every kernel slot AND the registered portable for `name`.

### [evoxc.random](/api/evoxc/random/)

- [`Algorithm`](/api/evoxc/random/algorithm/) — Canonical RNG algorithms (values are the canonical names).
- [`key`](/api/evoxc/random/key/) — Create a key from an int seed (polymorphic creator).
- [`multinomial`](/api/evoxc/random/multinomial/) — Draw `num_samples` indices from a 1-D probability distribution.
- [`normal`](/api/evoxc/random/normal/) — Draw normal values `mean + std * N(0,1)` from the key's stream.
- [`permutation`](/api/evoxc/random/permutation/) — Draw a uniformly random permutation of `0..n-1`.
- [`randint`](/api/evoxc/random/randint/) — Draw integer values in `[low, high)` (high exclusive).
- [`split`](/api/evoxc/random/split/) — Deterministically split one key into two independent keys.
- [`split_n`](/api/evoxc/random/split-n/) — Split one key into `n` independent keys (helper).
- [`uniform`](/api/evoxc/random/uniform/) — Draw uniform values in `[low, high)` from the key's stream.

### [evoxc.build_cache](/api/evoxc/build-cache/)

- [`CompileCache`](/api/evoxc/build-cache/compilecache/) — In-memory LRU compile cache (a `persist.cache.Cache` subclass).
- [`build_cached`](/api/evoxc/build-cache/build-cached/) — `build_cached(f, *specs, cache=None) -> Executable`.

### [evoxc.io](/api/evoxc/io/)

- [`AsyncCopy`](/api/evoxc/io/asynccopy/) — A scheduled host ↔ device copy (returned by `prefetch()`/`sink()`).
- [`prefetch`](/api/evoxc/io/prefetch/) — Schedule a host → device upload; returns an `AsyncCopy`.
- [`sink`](/api/evoxc/io/sink/) — Schedule a device → host download; returns an `AsyncCopy`.
- [`wait_all`](/api/evoxc/io/wait-all/) — Wait for every copy outstanding at call time (issue order) to finish.

- [`family_for_model_type`](/api/evoxc-hf/families/family-for-model-type/) — Resolve an HF `model_type` string (e.g.
- [`get_family`](/api/evoxc-hf/families/get-family/) — Look up a family by its `evoxc_hf` family key.

### [evoxc_hf.load](/api/evoxc-hf/load/)

- [`LoadedModel`](/api/evoxc-hf/load/loadedmodel/) — A checkpoint's static config and its canonical host parameters.

- [`load_hf`](/api/evoxc-hf/load/load-hf/) — Load a checkpoint directory into a `LoadedModel`.

### [evoxc_hf.ops](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/)

- [`activation_is_export_safe`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/activation-is-export-safe/) — Whether a graph built with this activation can be lowered to StableHLO.
- [`apply_rope`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/apply-rope/) — Rotate `(batch, heads, seq, head_dim)` queries/keys with HF `rotate_half`.
- [`causal_mask`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/causal-mask/) — In-graph `(seq_len, seq_len)` f32 additive causal mask.
- [`gelu_erf`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/gelu-erf/) — Exact erf-GELU: `0.5x(1 + erf(x / sqrt(2)))`.
- [`gelu_tanh`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/gelu-tanh/) — `gelu_new` / `gelu_pytorch_tanh`: `0.5x(1 + tanh(sqrt(2/pi)(x + 0.044715x^3)))`.
- [`layer_norm`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/layer-norm/) — HF `nn.LayerNorm`: biased variance over the **last** axis.
- [`merge_heads`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/merge-heads/) — `(b, n_heads, s, head_dim) -> (b, s, n_heads * head_dim)`.
- [`repeat_kv`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/repeat-kv/) — GQA/MQA expansion: `(b, n_kv, s, hd) -> (b, n_kv * n_rep, s, hd)`.
- [`resolve_activation`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/resolve-activation/) — Map an HF activation name to its graph-building activation function.
- [`rms_norm`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/rms-norm/) — HF `LlamaRMSNorm`: `weight * x * (1 / sqrt(mean(x^2, -1, keepdims) + eps))`.
- [`rope_cos_sin`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/rope-cos-sin/) — In-graph `(seq_len, head_dim)` f32 RoPE `(cos, sin)` tables.
- [`rope_tables`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/rope-tables/) — Host-side numpy f32 RoPE `(cos, sin)` tables — the reference oracle.
- [`silu`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/silu/) — SiLU / swish: `x * sigmoid(x)`.
- [`softmax`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/softmax/) — Numerically stable softmax over `axis`: `exp(x - max) / sum(exp(x - max))`.
- [`split_heads`](/api/evoxc-hf/ops/split-heads/) — `(b, s, n_heads * head_dim) -> (b, n_heads, s, head_dim)`.

### [evoxc_hf.pack](/api/evoxc-hf/pack/)

- [`is_packed_tree`](/api/evoxc-hf/pack/is-packed-tree/) — Whether a params tree (mapping or key iterable) uses packed input names.
- [`pack_params`](/api/evoxc-hf/pack/pack-params/) — Pack a canonical host params tree with `plan` (shorthand for `plan.pack`).
- [`pack_plan`](/api/evoxc-hf/pack/pack-plan/) — Build the packed-input plan for one canonical `param_specs` tree.

### [evoxc_hf.program](/api/evoxc-hf/program/)

- [`param_specs`](/api/evoxc-hf/program/param-specs/) — Return the `TensorSpec` of every **graph input** parameter.
- [`reference_logits`](/api/evoxc-hf/program/reference-logits/) — Compute the independent pure-numpy forward — the parity oracle.
- [`resolve_seq_len`](/api/evoxc-hf/program/resolve-seq-len/) — Resolve (and validate) the static sequence length of a graph.

### [evoxc_hf.reference](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/)

- [`additive_causal_mask`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/additive-causal-mask/) — Causal additive mask of shape `(seq_len, seq_len)` in float32.
- [`apply_rope`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/apply-rope/) — Rotate `x` with the HF `rotate_half` RoPE convention.
- [`attention`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/attention/) — Causal multi-head attention, one explicit Python loop per (batch, head).
- [`gelu_erf`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/gelu-erf/) — Exact (erf-form) GELU: `0.5 * x * (1 + erf(x / sqrt(2)))`.
- [`gelu_tanh`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/gelu-tanh/) — Tanh-approximated GELU — HF `gelu_new` / `gelu_pytorch_tanh`.
- [`layer_norm`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/layer-norm/) — HuggingFace `nn.LayerNorm` over the **last** axis (biased variance).
- [`param_count`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/param-count/) — Total number of scalar elements in a nested parameter tree.
- [`relu`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/relu/) — Rectified linear unit: `max(x, 0)`.
- [`resolve_activation`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/resolve-activation/) — Return the activation callable registered under `name`.
- [`rms_norm`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/rms-norm/) — HuggingFace `LlamaRMSNorm` over the **last** axis (no mean subtraction).
- [`rope_tables`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/rope-tables/) — Rotary-embedding cos/sin tables, bit-for-bit the HF computation.
- [`silu`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/silu/) — SiLU / swish: `x * sigmoid(x)`, evaluated in a numerically stable form.
- [`softmax`](/api/evoxc-hf/reference/softmax/) — Numerically stable softmax over `axis`.

- [`read_torch_bin`](/api/evoxc-hf/weights/read-torch-bin/) — Read a `pytorch_model.bin` checkpoint (zip **or** legacy format).
- [`state_dict_parameter_count`](/api/evoxc-hf/weights/state-dict-parameter-count/) — Total number of scalar parameters in `state_dict` (sum of element counts).

- [`forward_fn`](/api/evoxc-hf/program/forward-fn/) — Return the memoised `@evoxc.defn` forward for one static specialisation.
